## Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows [Development Standards](https://github.com/openaitx-system/GitHub_Copilot_Demo_20260221/wiki/Development-Standards)
- [ ] File-scoped namespaces used
- [ ] PascalCase for public members, _camelCase for private fields
- [ ] No `Console.WriteLine` in library code
- [ ] `ILogger<T>` used for logging
- [ ] No static mutable state
- [ ] Dependency injection used

### Documentation
- [ ] All public APIs have XML documentation comments
- [ ] Wiki updated (if spec changes needed)

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Test coverage > 80% on changed files
- [ ] Tests use xUnit + FluentAssertions
- [ ] Test names follow `Method_Scenario_Expected` pattern

### Git
- [ ] Commit messages follow [conventional format](https://github.com/openaitx-system/GitHub_Copilot_Demo_20260221/wiki/Git-Workflow-Standards)
- [ ] PR title follows `type(scope): description (#issue)` format
- [ ] Issue referenced in PR body
